type:

    And (@LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) C)
      (And (@LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne)) K)
        (∀ (epsilon : Real),
          @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero))
              epsilon →
            @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT epsilon
                (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real
                  (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne))
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 8)
                    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 8) Real.instNatCast
                      (@Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 7) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 7)))
                        (@Nat.instNeZeroSucc (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 6) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 6)))))))) →
              @Exists.{1} Real fun (D₀ : Real) =>
                And
                  (@LE.le.{0} Real Real.instLE
                    (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 2)
                      (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 2) Real.instNatCast
                        (@Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1)))
                          (@Nat.instNeZeroSucc (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 0) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 0)))))))
                    D₀)
                  (∀ (D : Real),
                    @LE.le.{0} Real Real.instLE D₀ D →
                      ∀ (N cap : Nat),
                        @Even.{0} Nat instAddNat N →
                          ∀ (retainOdd : List.{0} Nat → Bool) (z : Real),
                            have w : Real :=
                              @HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Real Real.instPow) D
                                (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real
                                  (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat
                                    (@NPow.toPow.{0} Real (@Monoid.toNPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid)))
                                  epsilon (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))));
                            have L : Real :=
                              @HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Real Real.instPow) D epsilon;
                            have V : Real := ImbalancedChen.actualSmallEulerProduct N cap w;
                            have E : Real := ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserDensityError C K D epsilon;
                            have S : Finset.{0} Nat := ImbalancedChen.fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z;
                            have c : (d : Nat) → Real := ImbalancedChen.fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z;

                                (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRoughModuli retainOdd N cap w z)
                                (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRoughRho retainOdd N cap w z L);
                            And

                                (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero))
                                (@HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHSub.{0} Real Real.instSub) density
                                  (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) V
                                    (ImbalancedChen.reciprocalTotientDensity S c))))
                              (@LE.le.{0} Real Real.instLE
                                (@HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHSub.{0} Real Real.instSub) density
                                  (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) V
                                    (ImbalancedChen.reciprocalTotientDensity S c)))
                                (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
                                  (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) V E)
